class_id: document cycle overrun / no calendar gate
symptom: the document cycle ran on EVERY 30-min pm2 wake with no weekday/holiday gate and two INDEPENDENT budgets (60s discovery + 25min extraction, no shared ceiling) that could together exceed the 30-min wake and the cycle lock's TTL, letting one wake overlap the next; observed 1,210-1,278s cycles and 105-115 network calls per cycle on a Sunday (2026-09-06)
fix_prs: calendar gate (`document-cycle-calendar-gate.ts`: Sunday/Saturday/NSE-holiday wakes make only UPCOMING/PRE_OPEN/OPEN candidates eligible for network work) + one shared wake budget (`DOCUMENT_CYCLE_WAKE_BUDGET_MS`, default 20min — extraction gets what discovery left, capped; `CYCLE_LOCK_TTL_MS` in index.ts now derived from the same budget + 5min slack instead of a separately-hardcoded number)
